title: Seaside Cottage Near Beach Access Sleeps 4
meta_description: 1BR Seaside cottage for 4 with partial Gulf views, a private balcony, outdoor shower, and a one-minute walk to beach access and Central Square.
description_expanded: Prime Seaside Location Near the BeachDreamboat is a charming one-bedroom guest home of the main home, Sabbatical, in the heart of Seaside, Florida, offering one of the most desirable locations along Scenic Highway 30A. Situated directly across from the beach on West Ruskin Street and just 266 feet from beach access, this Seaside vacation rental provides effortless access to the white-sand shoreline and emerald Gulf waters. Guests are also only one block from the Seaside Amphitheater and Central Square, placing live music, family-friendly events, and more than 40 shops and restaurants just steps away—ideal for couples or young families seeking a walkable Seaside getaway.Welcoming Outdoor Entry and Light-Filled Living SpaceAccessed by a sandy footpath, Dreamboat welcomes guests with bistro seating just outside the front door, perfect for morning coffee or relaxed evenings after the beach. Inside, the first floor features an airy, light-filled open layout designed for comfort and ease. The thoughtfully equipped kitchen includes a full-size dishwasher, under-counter refrigerator, microwave, Keurig and drip coffee maker, and a two-burner electric cooktop with oven—everything needed for simple meals during your coastal escape.Comfortable Main-Level Amenities for Relaxing or Remote WorkThe first-floor living space includes a cozy dining area for two, a queen sleeper sofa, flat-screen TV, and ample storage. A dedicated work desk tucked beneath the spiral staircase offers a convenient setup for remote work, making this home as functional as it is charming.Private Upstairs Bedroom with Gulf GlimpsesUpstairs, a spiral staircase leads to the queen primary bedroom with a renovated ensuite bathroom. Large windows fill the space with natural light and provide charming glimpses of the Gulf of Mexico just across the street. The bedroom features a wall-mounted flat-screen TV and a modern ensuite bath with a marble single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Open-Air Balcony for Coastal EveningsJust off the primary bedroom, an open-air balcony with bar seating for two overlooks the footpath and offers slight Gulf views. This intimate outdoor space is perfect for an evening nightcap while listening to the soothing sound of waves from the nearby beach.Added Conveniences for a Stress-Free StayAdditional amenities include a full-size stackable washer and dryer on the first floor and an outdoor shower off the front deck—ideal after a day spent at the beach. With its unbeatable proximity to the Gulf and Seaside town center, Dreamboat is a quintessential Seaside home rental offering comfort, convenience, and an exceptional coastal location along 30A.*3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. *Please be advised that neighboring properties may currently be undergoing construction or renovation during your stay. As a result, intermittent noise or construction-related activity may occur at certain times throughout the day. This work is managed by third parties outside of our control, and we appreciate your understanding while enjoying the property. For additional questions or concerns regarding nearby construction activity, please contact Homeowner’s Collection at 1-855-411-1557.FEATURESFeatures 470 square feet, located directly across from the beach226 feet or a 1-minute walk to beach access at West Ruskin PavilionOutdoor showerFull-size stackable washer and dryerPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided1 parking pass is issued (a golf cart is considered a car)Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002298
